programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S12/E12'. Geweld teen vrouens en kinders is een van Suid Afrika se walglikste kenmerke. Wanneer Altecia en haar dogter deur Altecia se eks doodgesteek word raak dit duidelik hoe lang pad ons land nog moet loop.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S12/E13'. Dekades se agteruitgang, jare se klagtes wat op dowe ore geval het, en selfs 'n laaste desperate onderhouds-poging, was nie genoeg om die katastrofiese Jagersfontein Slikramp in 2022 te verhoed nie.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E1'. Jaco Cloete en sy vrou was gesiene lede van die Melkbosstrand-gemeenskap tot sy inhegtenisneming vir beweerde bedrog. Hy het aanklagte van miljoene rande geëis en uiteindelik bankrotskap verklaar.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E2'. Richard 'Makka' Smit, en Natasha Booise se verhouding was gekenmerk deur besitlikheid en jaloesie. Op 2 Januarie 2022 skiet hy haar voor haar kind en ooggetuies.

programme.title: Verander jou siening
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Sumarie Jordaan daag plaaslike bekendes uit om 'n dag in die lewe van iemand met 'different abilities' te ervaar.

programme.title: Middeljare-mojo Met Marna
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Bea Potgieter se roerende verhaal van oorlewing en hoe sy uit die as herrys het. Voel jy verlore tussen al daardie velsorgprodukte? Shahnaz maak dit maklik vir jou. Plus: Suzette se slim raad vir enkelouers en alleenlopers.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E7'. Die eerstegeslag-entrepreneursboerderyfamilie Joos Solms (en kie) bedryf 'n boerdery, meule, bakkery-deli en gastehuis naby Winterton in KZN. Sy ingenieurs-onderneming, Plantkor, is ook diep betrokke in die landbousektor.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning
programme.desc: 'S1/E106'. Dié ontbytprogram sal seker maak Suid-Afrikaners begin hulle dag met al die inligting wat hulle kort. Ons dek alles van nuus en finansies tot leefstyl en vermaak en alles tussenin.

programme.title: Die Tuinmakers
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Margot van der Westhuizen het die kantoor vir die buitelewe verruil en skep tuine geïnspireer deur die natuur en haar kinderjare.

programme.title: Wie Was Dit?
programme.desc: 'S3/E4'. Die speurders span saam om nog 'n fiktiewe moord op te los. Wie gaan vennootskappe sluit en wie gaan leidrade koop?

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S18/E2'. In Februarie 2024 verdwyn die 6-jarige Joshlin Smith in Middelpos, Saldanha. Die verdwyning het die hele Suid-Afrika aangegryp, maar wat het gebeur dat 3 mense weens mensehandel tot lewenslange tronkstraf.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning
programme.desc: 'S1/E106'. Dié ontbytprogram sal seker maak Suid-Afrikaners begin hulle dag met al die inligting wat hulle kort. Ons dek alles van nuus en finansies tot leefstyl en vermaak en alles tussenin.

programme.title: Ons Gesels Troeteldiere
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Janke Nortjie deel haar hasiestories, ons ontmoet Bjorn Unger se reptielvriende, en Bernice van Huyssteen gee raad oor eksotiese troeteldiere.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E6'. Revell Saint se entrepreneursgees het die 110 ha waarmee hy 40 j. gelede begin het, uitgebou in 'n onderneming wat bykans honderdvoudig deur KZN en die Oos-Kaap strek.

programme.title: 'n Nuwe jy met Nova
programme.desc: 'S2/E4'. Chantell Rudolph, 'n ma van sewe, dra swaar aan 'n donker verlede wat sy graag agter haar wil los. 'n Nuwe glimlag is die beginpunt van 'n pad na genesing en vernuwing.

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Boompie Alleen: Hierdie week is ons in Vrede in die Vrystaat en ontmoet die Fourie-familie, wat al vir vyf generasies met beeste en sojabone boer.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning
programme.desc: 'S1/E106'. Dié ontbytprogram sal seker maak Suid-Afrikaners begin hulle dag met al die inligting wat hulle kort. Ons dek alles van nuus en finansies tot leefstyl en vermaak en alles tussenin.

programme.title: Manne Agter Die Potte
programme.desc: 'S1/E7'. Kosmaak is in Marcus Gericke se bloed, en hy volg trots in sy pa se voetspore. As hoofsjef by Chorus op Waterkloof-wynlandgoed bied hy eenvoudige, seisoenale kookkuns met 'n geheimsinnige aanslag.

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S13/E10'. Ons gunstelingtydverdryf is nou 'n sosiale eksperiment. Drie paartjies wat mekaar nie ken nie, braai by mekaar en heelwat gebeur om die vuur. En ons praat nie net van die lekker kos nie!

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S3/E1'. Drie deelnemers probeer mekaar nie net met hul algemene kennis uitoorlê nie, maar ook met hul kennis van mense. Die een wat sy teenstanders die beste opsom en met die regte vrae teiken, kan met groot geld wegstap.

programme.title: Ons Gesels Balans
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Dit kan moeilik wees om balans te vind wanneer jou huishouding uitbrei. Hierdie week kom kuier my vriendin Kara du Toit, aktrise en nuwe mamma, by my. Ons gesels oor hoe om balans te vind as jong ma en deel praktiese wenke.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E7'. Die eerstegeslag-entrepreneursboerderyfamilie Joos Solms (en kie) bedryf 'n boerdery, meule, bakkery-deli en gastehuis naby Winterton in KZN. Sy ingenieurs-onderneming, Plantkor, is ook diep betrokke in die landbousektor.

programme.title: 'n Nuwe jy met Nova
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. Op die oog af het jong mamma Chante Serfontein alles onder beheer, maar onder die oppervlak skuil onsekerhede en innerlike seer. Elana help haar om haar vel én haar hart 'n nuwe lus vir die lewe te gee.

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond

programme.desc: 'S34/E4 - Stick To Your Ribs Recipes'. The gang turn summer's greatest comfort foods into hearty family meals, including slow cooker ribs, spicy slaw and a vegetable gratin.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S50/E1 - Time Capsule: '60s Foods!'. The competing chefs have to cook with foods that were popular in the 1960s. A certain soda and some sweet meat are part of the appetizer basket.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E19 - Quito'. Andrew Zimmern explores culinary diversity in Ecuador's capital by tasting its classic dishes: fried pork and potato cakes, ceviche, sugared peanuts, fish soup and more.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E20 - Antigua Guatemala'. Andrew explores vibrant cuisine of Antigua Guatemala, a culinary fusion of Mayan and Spanish heritage. He tries enchiladas, tamales, plantains and more.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E21 - Cartagena'. Andrew Zimmern delights in the tempting flavours of Cartagena. From fish and egg arepas and seafood stews to bedroom-boosting fruits he tastes the coast in every bite.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E22 - Dominican Republic'. Andrew is on a culinary tour of the Dominican Republic, a meat lover's paradise. He samples roast pig, seven-meat stew and finds this place full of surprises.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E23 - Oaxaca'. Andrew explores regional specialities in Oaxaca, Mexico. From mole negro, tortilla with pork lard to egg bread dunked in hot chocolate, local tradition flavours each bite.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E24 - Baja'. Andrew explores the seafood-rich cuisine of Baja California, Mexico. Smoked tuna, fish tacos, and zesty seafood cocktail hangover cures - Baja's cuisine is sensational!

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S21/E4 - Game Day Super Teams'. Guy Fieri pairs former NFL players with all-star judges. They have a series of exciting challenges to see which team will come out on top.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S28/E14 - Playin' Chicken'. Guy plays a tasty game of chicken all over the US. He finds it Nashville hot-style in California and French-style at a pizza-pasta place in Seattle!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S28/E15 - On The Hook And In The Bun'. Guy reels in yummy seafood and serious sandwiches. He checks out a fresh poke burger on Hawaii and pork buns and dim sum chicken feet in San Francisco.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S2/E11 - Dangerous Decadence'. The chefs use dangerously delicious ingredients like a scary, hairy creepy-crawly in the first basket! And the second basket ranges from poisonous to mouldy.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay

programme.desc: 'S3/E9 - Titans Vs Michael Jenkins'. Michael Jenkins has judged each of the Titans before. He uses that knowledge to his advantage in the Triple Threat kitchen.

programme.title: The Kitchen

programme.title: AlUla Tour '26: Stage 1
programme.desc: Stage 1: AlUla Camel Cup Track > AlUla Camel Cup Track (158 km). This stage forms a fast, wide open desert loop, with long straightaways and minimal elevation, it strongly favors pure sprinters who can handle crosswinds.

programme.title: AlUla Tour '26: Stage 2
programme.desc: Stage 2: AlManshiyah Train Station > AlManshiyah Train Station (152 km). This loop begins and ends at the historic Hijaz railway station. Riders navigate smooth roads, gentle undulations, and scenic valleys near Winter Park.

programme.title: AlUla Tour '26: Stage 3
programme.desc: Stage 3: Winter Park > Bir Jaydah Mountain Wirkah (142.1 km). The race shifts dramatically into climbing territory, with the final 4.9 km average around 5.9%, and the last 2 km rising above 7%.

programme.title: AlUla Tour '26: Stage 4
programme.desc: Stage 4: Winter Park > Shalal Sijlyat Rocks (184 km). This stage returns to the exposed desert roads leading to the dramatic Shalal Sijlyat Rocks. Crosswinds terrain will shape the race, but it is expected to favor the sprinters.

programme.title: AlUla Tour '26: Stage 5
programme.desc: Stage 5: AlUla Old Town > Skyviews of Harrat Uwayrid (163.9 km). The grand finale delivers a spectacular uphill finish, offering panoramic desert views. This stage often decides the overall general classification.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Hit The Road: Hokkaido Hakodate
programme.desc: Our journey begins in Hokkaido, heading through the winter southwest to Hakodate, where history meets one of Japan's most breathtaking night views.

programme.title: Core Kyoto Mini
programme.desc: Miyama is famous for its roof-thatching tradition - the town of Hanase continues to serve its local speciality, foraged wild food cuisine.

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
programme.desc: This time: relaying messages. Dong Quoc Dung was transferred to a Japanese headquarters in 2018 - he is expected to return one day and be a hub for HQ. He learns how to take messages accurately.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: Anyone can come in and make clothes at Yoshimura Mayu's atelier - the materials are discards from industry and major brands, and working together leads to great ideas they couldn't come up with alone.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: Bari is a port town found at the heel of the Italian peninsula - an important hub of commerce since the time of ancient Rome, it's known for welcoming people of diverse cultures from Asia and Africa.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: In Pursuit Of Sustainable Fashion
programme.desc: Shocked by what he saw in India's textile industry, Aditya travelled to Japan to find a better way to produce fabric - he works with a start-up that's hoping to change how we create clothes.

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change The World
programme.desc: Japanese chum salmon migrate over 20,000 kilometres in their return journey across the North Pacific - global warming has caused an alarming decline in returning salmon and requires urgent action.

programme.title: Designs That Connect Gaps
programme.desc: Graphic designer Sato Taku visits Miyazaki - the crowded signs of local bars inspire Sato to reconsider the conventions of modern design and embrace the appeal of the unknown.

programme.title: Where We Call Home
programme.desc: We meet Canadian-born David Moreton who's a guide for foreign tourists undertaking a pilgrimage that tours 88 Buddhist temples around Shikoku, and American Patrick Brown who crafts beer in Tokushima.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Kaizoku
programme.desc: The Murakami Kaizoku were seafarers and fighters in the Seto Inland Sea - we explore their history and legacy with footage from time-lapse creator Shimizu Daisuke. This time: Nii Oshima Island.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: From protecting valuable ceramics to reinforcing World Heritage structures, we see how the latest disaster preparedness technology is safeguarding Japan's irreplaceable cultural properties.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture - this episode looks at words related to hair. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: Easy Japanese

programme.title: Bosai: Be Prepared
programme.desc: What preparations are needed to protect children in the event of a disaster? This episode considers not only their physical safety, but also their mental wellbeing during stressful evacuations.
